approval_boundary_details: No universal action/argument-bound approval system found. Actions execute via core/action_loader.py dispatch without pre-execution confirmation, permission checks, or audit-logged results.
recommended_next_steps: Add typed action registry with input validation, required permissions, side-effect metadata, timeouts, auditable results.
Implement timezone-aware scheduler with recurring execution, dedupe, missed-run handling, visible run history.
Add connector interfaces for calendar, email, weather, messaging with credential checks.
Add approval boundary: confirmation for destructive changes, external sends, permission modifications.
Bind approvals to exact action + arguments presented to user.
verdict: 50 actions exist but none carry permission/timeout/audit metadata. No scheduler, no dedupe, no timezone support. Only 2 connector interfaces. No approval boundary.
